title: Mycelium Growth
definition: The process of developing and strengthening the knowledge graph of a language model.

difficulty_levels.beginner: The act of providing new information to a language model, helping it learn and become smarter over time.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The strategic process of enhancing a language model's knowledge base through targeted data acquisitions and refinements.
difficulty_levels.expert: The art of cultivating a language model's reasoning abilities by nurturing its relationships and understanding across various domains, aimed at improving its performance and versatility.

extra_fields.insight: The continuous improvement of a language model through systematic and strategic data acquisition and refinement.
